query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.cardNumber,
       COUNT(ph.id) as psa10Count30d,
       AVG(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as psa10Avg30d,
       MIN(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as psa10Min30d,
       MAX(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as psa10Max30d
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN priceHistory ph ON c.id = ph.cardId 
  AND ph.source = 'snkrdunk' 
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Lillie%Full Force%' OR c.nameJa LIKE '%リーリエの全力%'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.cardNumber
ORDER BY c.id;
